channel.title: Campaign Producers Insights
channel.description: Practical, source-backed thinking on campaign briefs, specialist teams, production choices, AI and accountable campaign leadership.

item.title: Creative feedback is a decision system, not a comments thread.
item.description: Better creative review is not about collecting more reactions. It is about deciding what the work must do, who decides and which evidence matters.

item.title: Brief the commercial change, not the list of deliverables.
item.description: A list of assets tells people what to make. A useful campaign brief tells them what must change, why it matters and how the work will be judged.

item.title: AI, traditional or hybrid? Start with the campaign job.
item.description: The most expensive production mistake is choosing the method before deciding what the campaign must make people notice, feel or do.
